enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Turning to the left. Pulling blanket. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Turning to the right. Stretching legs. Yawning. Turning to back. Pulling blanket up. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Breathing deeply. Turning to left. Pulling blanket. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning shower and wash after Member 1 finishes in the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom door. Knock and wait for Member 1 to exit. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Dry with towel. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Having breakfast with Member 1 in the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Say 'Good morning' to Member 1. Member 1 replies 'Morning'. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Lift food to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Drink. Put down cup. Talk to Member 1 about the day. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Pick up plate. Carry plate to sink. Return to table. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and planning the day on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Log in. Open email client. Click on first email. Read email. Reply to email. Delete spam email. Open calendar. Add event. Write notes. Close email client. Open document. Review plan. Save document. Turn off monitor. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open illustration software. Create new canvas. Pick up stylus. Draw sketch lines. Use eraser tool. Apply color. Adjust brush size. Use keyboard shortcut to save. Save file. Pick up phone. Check message. Put down phone. Continue drawing. Zoom in. Zoom out. Add layers. Merge layers. Save file again. Stretch arms. Continue working.

enriched_activities.activity: Making tea and taking a short break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Put tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour water into mug. Add milk. Stir. Sit at kitchen table. Drink tea. Check phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance illustration work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open illustration software. Pick up stylus. Continue drawing. Apply shading. Adjust colors. Use undo. Save file. Check reference image. Adjust monitor. Draw details. Use zoom. Save file. Stretch. Continue. Save file. Close software. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch with Member 1 and cleaning up the dishes afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Eat. Talk to Member 1. Drink water. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plates. Scrape food into bin. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up cloth. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Put away cloth. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing with Member 1, air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch TV. Talk to Member 1. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Lean back. Watch TV. Laugh. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust sitting position.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing to relax and watch TV with Member 1, air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change volume. Put down remote. Talk to Member 1. Pick up cup. Drink. Put down cup. Watch TV. Adjust cushion. Lean back. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check message. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stretch legs. Watch TV. Adjust position.

enriched_activities.activity: Handling arts administration tasks on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Open document. Write text. Save document. Open email. Send email. Check calendar. Schedule meeting. Open file. Review budget. Edit spreadsheet. Save file. Close programs. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room, the chore left by Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum floor. Move coffee table. Vacuum under table. Vacuum sofa. Turn off. Unplug. Put away vacuum. Pick up cushions. Fluff cushions. Arrange cushions. Pick up items from floor. Put items in place. Wipe table. Adjust curtains. Look around. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a walk in the park with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open door. Walk out. Walk to park. Enter park. Walk along path. Talk to Member 1. Look at trees. Stop to rest. Continue walking. Observe birds. Walk around pond. Talk to Member 1. Walk back. Exit park. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Remove shoes. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry with towel. Brush hair. Apply deodorant. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and listening to music while Member 1 prepares dinner ingredients in the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select playlist. Play music. Put down phone. Listen to music. Tap foot. Close eyes. Hum. Adjust volume. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put down magazine. Listen. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Talk to Member 1. Return to sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Put on apron. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Open pot. Stir ingredients. Add spices. Taste food. Adjust seasoning. Stir again. Turn off stove. Pick up plates. Set table. Call Member 1. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Eat. Talk to Member 1. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Talk. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate. Carry to sink. Return to table. Sit down. Talk more. Drink. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a movie on TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select movie. Play movie. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch movie. Talk to Member 1. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Put down snack. Watch movie. Laugh. Pick up drink. Drink. Put down drink. Watch movie.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime skincare and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse. Apply toner. Apply moisturizer. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas. Pull back blanket. Get into bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read first page. Turn page. Read second page. Turn page. Read third page. Adjust pillow. Read fourth page. Turn page. Read fifth page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Turning to the left. Pulling blanket. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Turning to the right. Stretching legs. Yawning. Turning to back. Pulling blanket up. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Breathing deeply. Turning to left. Pulling blanket. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still.
